subject: CAIQ observability trace-map and evidence gateway onboarding
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@pacificbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Audit Team <audit@pacificbank.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Mapping ask: runtime observability evidence for CAIQ submission

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick handoff last week. Our SOC team is finalizing the CAIQ for our cloud provider lineup and they want a compact mapping that ties runtime observability controls (logging, traces, telemetry retention, keystore access events) to concrete artifacts.

Specifically, could you:
- Confirm which CAIQ controls map to the runtime "observability/telemetry" group in your catalog.
- Share short-form evidence (log snapshot examples, trace sample names, retention policy doc excerpts) and a recommended folder layout for our auditors.

We're aiming to close this by Nov 24 (internal deadline). If you can provide an initial trace-map and instructions for the evidence gateway upload, that'll help accelerate the review.

Appreciate it — Priya
Audit Lead, Cloud Assurance
Pacific Bank

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@pacificbank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mapping ask: runtime observability evidence for CAIQ submission

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a concise trace-map workbook that maps CAIQ control IDs to our observability artifacts and owner contacts. High-level notes:

• Controls covered: CSA-CM-07, CSA-OT-03, CSA-IM-02 (see the workbook for the full crosswalk).
• Evidence types we can supply quickly: retention policy excerpt (sys-retention-v2), sample trace export (trace-id sample list), and syslog snippet with redaction markers.
• Ownership: Runtime traces and KV cache logs are owned by "platform-observability" (Jonas will be the contact for any live extractions).

Marissa and I can stage the evidence to the gateway once you grant the upload window. I included a stubbed folder layout in the workbook and a short PDF with the gateway upload steps.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the auditor account that needs write access to the evidence gateway.
2) We open a short window (2 days) starting Monday 11/22 to populate the folder with the zipped artifacts.
3) We provide a 30-minute walkthrough on 11/23 to show where each artifact maps to CAIQ claims.

If any of that timeline needs compression let us know — we can deliver an initial package earlier but it will omit the full trace export set.

Best,
Irene
Security & Controls Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-caiq-tracemap-v1.xlsx, evidence-gateway-access-instructions.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@pacificbank.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mapping ask: runtime observability evidence for CAIQ submission

Priya — quick operational note from the runtime side.

We can provide:
- A traced sample export (GZIP) that includes 5 anonymized traces demonstrating request routing and cache hits. Filenames use the trace-id pattern: redwood-trace-202611-<sample>.
- A redacted syslog snippet showing keystore access events (we will redact PII and key identifiers).
- A retention policy excerpt (sys-retention-v2) and a short README explaining sampling logic.

For the evidence gateway upload: please share the uploader account (email) and whether you prefer SFTP or the web portal. We currently have an "evidence-uploader" role that will accept scoped uploads for 48 hours.

Irene, I can run the extraction on Monday morning (11/22) and coordinate the upload if Priya confirms the account.

—Jonas
Head, Observability
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@pacificbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Audit Team <audit@pacificbank.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mapping ask: runtime observability evidence for CAIQ submission

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed.

Uploader account for the gateway: audit.uploader+pacific@pacificbank.com (please grant web-portal write access for 24 hours starting 2026-11-22T08:00 PST). We prefer the web portal for quick review.

Irene/Jonas, please proceed with the Monday extraction and upload. Marissa, can you send the 30-minute walkthrough invite for 11/23 09:00 PST and include the CAIQ control sheet in the calendar invite?

Two small asks for the auditors: when you upload the trace GZIP, include a short manifest (manifest.txt) that lists sample filenames and the CAIQ control each sample substantiates. That makes our review much faster.

Appreciate the responsiveness — Priya
Audit Lead, Cloud Assurance
Pacific Bank
